description: We are conducting a confidential search for a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This pivotal role offers an exceptional opportunity to oversee all operational aspects, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, regulatory compliance, and financial performance.The successful LNHA will be responsible for fostering a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff. You will guide a compassionate team, implement strategic initiatives, and drive continuous improvement in all areas of the facility. This is a chance to make a significant impact within a reputable organization committed to excellence in post-acute care.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated success in facility operations, financial management, and regulatory compliance.
Strong leadership abilities with a focus on quality patient care and staff development.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Missouri Valley, IA. This is a fantastic opportunity for a Registered Nurse with a passion for patient assessment and care planning to make a significant impact. We are looking for a permanent team member, not an interim candidate, who is ready to contribute to a supportive and dynamic environment.

In this vital role, you will be responsible for coordinating the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessment process, ensuring accurate and timely completion of assessments in accordance with federal and state regulations. Your expertise will be crucial in developing comprehensive care plans that reflect the individual needs of our residents, contributing to their overall well-being and quality of life.

This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $65,000 - $75,000 per year, commensurate with your experience and qualifications. Join a team committed to excellence in resident care and professional growth.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process and Medicare/Medicaid regulations
Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) for a full-time, 12-hour PM shift position at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Red Bay, AL. This is an immediate opening for a compassionate and skilled nurse ready to make a significant impact on patient care.

In this vital role, you will be responsible for providing comprehensive nursing care, administering medications, monitoring patient conditions, and collaborating with the healthcare team to ensure the highest standards of resident well-being. Your commitment to excellence will directly contribute to a positive and healing environment.

If you are an experienced RN looking for a challenging yet rewarding opportunity with consistent 12-hour shifts, we encourage you to apply today and join a team dedicated to exceptional patient outcomes.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Alabama
Minimum of one year of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong clinical assessment and documentation skills

description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Marketing Director to join our growing healthcare organization. This is a fully remote opportunity, allowing you to contribute your expertise from anywhere. You will be instrumental in shaping our brand presence and driving strategic marketing initiatives.

In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive marketing strategies to enhance our reach and engagement. Your efforts will directly support our mission to provide exceptional healthcare services, working collaboratively to achieve organizational goals.

This full-time position offers an annual salary range of $70,000 - $80,000. We are actively scheduling interviews Monday-Friday from 1 PM-7 PM, with weekend availability as needed, to accommodate qualified candidates.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within the healthcare sector
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute successful marketing strategies
Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills
Proficiency in digital marketing tools and analytics
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field
